traits.name: Slow
traits.text: A zombie is permanently slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

traits.name: Corpse Throwing
traits.text: A zombie hulk can throw corpses at foes. While any Medium dead body will do, they sometimes throw zombie shamblers, who take just as much damage from being thrown as the target they hit. A thrown shambler lands prone, but if it's not destroyed, it can rise and use other actions normally.

traits.name: Wide Swing
traits.text: ⬻ The zombie hulk makes a hunk of meat Strike and compares the attack roll result to the AC of up to two foes, each of whom must be within the Strike's reach. This attack counts as two attacks for the zombie hulk's multiple attack penalty.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ hunk of meat +17 (reach 15 feet); Damage 2d10+9 (2d10+9) bludgeoning

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ hunk of meat +9 (thrown 10 feet); Damage 2d10+9 (2d10+9) bludgeoning

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ corpse +17 (brutal, range increment 30 feet); Damage 2d6+9 (2d6+9) bludgeoning
